description: The project is also expected to focus on key sectors such as healthcare, robotics and data analytics, encouraging the development of AI-driven solutions in diagnostics and automation.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh is set to take a major leap in its digital transformation journey with the proposed Artificial Intelligence City in Lucknow, an ambitious project aimed at positioning the state among the world’s leading technology hubs. Backed by an investment of Rs 10,752 crore, the project reflects Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s push to integrate innovation, sustainability and economic growth. The AI City, planned over more than 70 acres, is being developed as a next-generation technology ecosystem under the Public Private Partnership model.
